description: This file defines inline elements and parsing logic for Markdown syntax, including classes for text, links, images, emojis, and line breaks, as well as functions for parsing inline Markdown components.

classes.name: Inline
classes.description: Interface for inline Markdown elements with method IsInline.

classes.name: inlineBase
classes.description: Base struct implementing Inline interface, used for embedding in other inline element structs.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Represents plain text in Markdown with associated range.

classes.name: InlineLinkOrImage
classes.description: Represents a link or image with children, destination, and title.

classes.name: ReferenceLinkOrImage
classes.description: Represents a reference-style link or image with a reference definition.

classes.name: Autolink
classes.description: Represents an automatic link (URL or WWW).

classes.name: Emoji
classes.description: Represents an emoji with a name.

classes.name: delimiter
classes.description: Struct for managing link/image delimiters during parsing.

classes.name: inlineParser
classes.description: Internal parser struct for processing inline Markdown syntax.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Returns unescaped destination URL or link.

methods.name: parseBackticks
methods.description: Parses inline code spans delimited by backticks.

methods.name: parseLineEnding
methods.description: Handles line ending parsing, distinguishing hard and soft breaks.

methods.name: parseText
methods.description: Parses plain text until special characters.

methods.name: parseLinkOrImageDelimiter
methods.description: Handles parsing of link/image delimiters '[' and '!['.

methods.name: peekAtInlineLinkDestinationAndTitle
methods.description: Peeks ahead to parse link destination and optional title.

methods.name: referenceDefinition
methods.description: Finds reference definition matching a label.

methods.name: lookForLinkOrImage
methods.description: Attempts to resolve link/image references from delimiters.

methods.name: CharacterReference
methods.description: Converts character references to Unicode characters.

methods.name: parseAutolink
methods.description: Parses autolinks like URLs and WWW links.

methods.name: ParseInlines
methods.description: Public function to parse inline Markdown elements from raw text.

methods.name: MergeInlineText
methods.description: Merges consecutive Text nodes into a single node.

methods.name: Unescape
methods.description: Unescapes Markdown escape sequences and entities.
